name: Find companies that raised and are hiring with Bounce Watch in Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Find companies that raised and are hiring with Bounce Watch in Google Sheets

Bounce Watch tells you what just happened at a company and when — funding, senior hires, new offices, customer wins and partnerships, each carrying its own date. What the API covers: bouncewatch.com/products/data-enrichment-api

Money in the bank and open senior roles is the pairing most sales teams want: budget has arrived and the team is being built. This workflow finds the companies showing both in the same window and writes them to a spreadsheet.

### How it works

A weekly schedule starts the run. A Settings node holds the country and the lookback window, so the search changes shape in one place. The Bounce Watch node searches for two signal types at once — a funding round and a senior hire — with "require all keys" switched on, so a company has to show both rather than either. Each match becomes one row in Google Sheets: the company, what matched, and the date of the most recent one.

### Setup

1. Get an API key at bouncewatch.com/register/api. It is free, no card, and every new account starts with 2,500 credits. Paste it into the Bounce Watch credential.
2. Set the country code and the window in Search settings.
3. Pick your Google Sheets credential, then choose the spreadsheet and tab.

The importance floor keeps background chatter — event attendance, news mentions, follower drift — out of the result. An empty run means nothing matched the filters, not that those companies were quiet.

### Customization tips

Change the two signal keys to any pair you care about: an office opening plus a partnership, a customer win plus a product launch. Turn "require all keys" off to widen it back to either signal.

## When and where to look

Weekly run, one country, one window.
Everything you would change lives here.

## The companies doing both

Funding and a senior hire in the same window.
One row per company.
